text: Unfortunately, this app has been crashing on me almost every👏 single👏 time👏 I try to record a habit on the widget. It's really quite annoying. This only started *after* I bought lifetime access to this app, so I think the app developers no longer care about my feedback (they were initially responsive, then ghosted me). text: Thanks for fixing the app. Previous Review: Was a fantastic app... That’s why it gets two stars instead of one. Unfortunately, the new filter and list system is a step backwards. Now all tasks and habits are displayed, even when they’re not due on a certain date. Before, everything was added automatically without extra steps, and future tasks wouldn’t clutter up other days. Now I have to update every single one of my tasks or habits just to make it work again. No thanks.
author: Yanic Kummli
developer_reply: This was actually due to a bug in our system and not an intended change. Habit scheduling is completely separate from the new List & Filter system. Please update your app to the latest version and everything will be fixed!

text: The App looks great, I love the design. Also the suggestions are great. My problem is the limited functionality. I was looking for a tracker, that allows me to follow my morning routine. That includes tasks with a duration of a minute or less. The minimum duration for any activity is 15min. That seems odd to me espescially for activities like "wake up early". Thus all the activities I want to perform in the first 15min of the day have to start at the same time and take 15 min.
author: ToodLee
developer_reply: Thanks for that feedback! We plan to support more flexibility in the Schedule feature in a future update, including creating events shorter than 15 minutes and setting the start time to whatever you'd like. Stay tuned!
